Description:
[center][color=#9fc5e8][b]Hello! This is dolli~ ^^[/b][/color]

I said it once and I'll say it again, I shall never tire myself of admiring your pretty art style, Adore, never in this life nor in the second!
[i]
Read my T.O.U. at the very bottom ^^[/i]


==========================================================

My folders will contain both XNB and PNG files of the Abigail character sprite sheet. It's up to you if you want to use the PNG one or the XNB. Personally, I use XNBs, but that does not mean it is a safer option.
If you chose to edit your game files (Content Folder), make sure you have an untouched copy of that same folder for safe keeping.

-

[u][b]If you decided to use the XNB file I provided (it is not recommended, but it is optional), just copy it from the extracted folder, find the file path - which is;[/b][/u]

[color=#b4a7d6][b]Stardew Valley ➡ Content ➡ Characters[/b][/color]

... paste it into your Character folder and click "replace."

-

[u][b]The PNG option needs SMAPI. Just extract this folder into your Mods file and the API should do its thing. [/b][/u]

However, if you already have a mod that helps you replace portraits and characters like Portraiture or CP Base Retexture Mod (a mod created by Tee Slang or TSlang ^^) without editing anything — such mods are also welcomed options, if not recommended
.
